The existing lab has static IPv4 routing across ten LANs and no DNS configured. A DNS server on an existing router can provide the requested names without changing the topology or routes.

The working specification is:

- Use the current lab directory and its existing `kathara/base` images. Run BIND on **r4**, reachable at `10.15.5.1`, and configure all 40 PCs to use it as their DNS resolver.
- Preserve existing IP addresses, links, startup behavior and static routes. Add persistent BIND configuration and zone files under the lab directory, and start the service from `r4.startup`.
- Create authoritative local zones containing these records:

| Name | Machine | IPv4 address |
|---|---|---|
| shop.example.com | pc16 | 10.15.4.14 |
| blog.example.com | pc17 | 10.15.5.11 |
| dept.company.com | pc18 | 10.15.5.12 |
| intranet.company.com | pc19 | 10.15.5.13 |
| api.service.com | pc20 | 10.15.5.14 |
| ai.research.lab.net | pc22 | 10.15.6.12 |
| data.research.lab.net | pc23 | 10.15.6.13 |
| dev.lab.net | pc24 | 10.15.6.14 |
| ci.tools.net | pc25 | 10.15.7.11 |
| vpn.university.edu | pc26 | 10.15.7.12 |
| courses.university.edu | pc27 | 10.15.7.13 |
| portal.campus.edu | pc28 | 10.15.7.14 |
| studenti.unibo.it | pc29 | 10.15.8.11 |
| servizi.comune.it | pc30 | 10.15.8.12 |
| dati.regione.it | pc31 | 10.15.8.13 |
| mail.company.com | pc7 | 10.15.2.13 |
| mail.university.edu | pc11 | 10.15.3.13 |

Add MX records for `company.com` and `university.edu` pointing to their respective mail names. These records enable mail-server discovery; they do not themselves install or configure mail delivery.

After implementation, validate DNS configuration and each A and MX record, then check resolution and connectivity from PCs in different LANs. These are internal lab records; no public DNS publication is assumed.

No files have been changed. The [kathara-creation skill](/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-43fd2_kv/lab/.codex/skills/kathara-creation/SKILL.md) explicitly separates the specification from creation: “Only start creating files after the user asks to create the scenario starting from the generated prompt.” If this specification is suitable, please ask me to implement it in the lab.
